source.note: Start 500 mg twice daily or 850 mg once daily; max 2550 mg/day in divided doses, above 2000 mg possibly three times daily. Per dose: typical 500 (twice daily); max 1000 = 2000 mg/day twice daily (2550 mg/day three times daily = 850 per dose). Label is a generic (Aurobindo); Glucophage itself is no longer on DailyMed.
'approximately 50% to 60%' (500 mg tablet, fasting) model = midpoint of the label range (curve value; change if you prefer another)
plasma half-life 'approximately 6.2 hours' (17.6 h in blood)
Label gives apparent V/F = 654 L (single 850 mg dose). The curve needs V, so V = 654 x 0.55 (model bioavailability) = 359.7 L.
Table 4, healthy adults: Tmax 2.75 h (500 mg single dose) and 2.64 h (850 mg single dose) model = midpoint of the label range (curve value; change if you prefer another)

'approximately 90% of the absorbed drug is eliminated via the renal route within the first 24 hours'; not metabolized, so it leaves unchanged. Fractions are of the absorbed drug. OCT2/MATE transporters are named in section 7 without a major/minor role, so they are left out.

journey.text: About half to 60% of a dose is absorbed from the gut. Food lowers and slows absorption a little.
Lowers blood sugar mainly by making the liver release less sugar, and helps the body respond better to insulin.
Not broken down at all: the absorbed drug leaves unchanged in urine, about 90% within a day.
